commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a thief of Nesh-Deeka house in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. Nesh-Deeka says the carving is Kothringi and sent me to Toklea to show it to the Chime-Keepers elder. 2. Go into the Kothringi Greathouse at Toklea and show the keystone to Hums-the-Long-Note, the elder (the quest marker). 3. I can talk to the elder and show the keystone, quietly. I have not seen other choices yet. 4. I do not understand seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, or the Collector Ennodius Vanin. I could ask the elder or others about them.

answer 1. Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone but wants payment first: her family carved grave-stake, in a chest in drowned Zul-Etha. 2. Go to Zul-Etha (south-east from Mir-Xal quay) and take the grave-stake from the unlocked Drowned Chest, then bring it back. 3. Crocodiles and an old bull lie on three roof peaks. I could kill them from a roof or with arrows, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen. As a quiet thief, swimming unseen seems best. 4. I do not know Mir-Xal or Zul-Etha beyond what she said. I still do not know seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel or Ennodius Vanin; maybe she will tell me later.

answer 1. I have the grave-stake from the drowned chest; the crocodiles did not trouble me. Hums-the-Long-Note will tell me about the keystone once I bring it. 2. Return to Hums-the-Long-Note in the Kothringi Greathouse, Toklea, and give her the stake. 3. Just hand it over and ask about the keystone; nothing else is offered. 4. Still unknown: seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin. Hopefully Hums-the-Long-Note explains.

answer 1. Hums-the-Long-Note took the stake and told me the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall north of Gideon. The knights of Gideon were the last guards of the kings road to the Root. 2. Report to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. I could report to Nesh-Deeka as told, or go to Eurydike myself first; the journal only points to Nesh-Deeka. 4. Still unknown: seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin. I do not know exactly what the tomb holds beyond what marked the way.

answer 1. The quest is done. The keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike near Gideon; Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold and said to hurry because the Unbound are asking Gideon diggers about Eurydike. 2. Nothing is set; the next step would be to go to Eurydike quickly. 3. Go to Eurydike myself with the keystone, or ask Nesh-Deeka more. 4. Still unknown: seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin, and how Nesh-Deeka knows (she says we listen).

answer I am Tarin, thief of Nesh-Deeka house in Helstrom, with about 650 gold, the Kothringi Keystone, Old Silver Setting, lockpick and Voh-Vastei armour. Hums-the-Long-Note, Chime-Keeper elder at Toklea, told me for the price of her family grave-stake, which I took quietly from the chest in drowned Zul-Etha, that the keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall just north of Gideon. The knights of Gideon were the last guards of the kings road to the Root. I told Nesh-Deeka, who paid 100 gold and said to hurry: the Unbound are asking Gideon diggers about Eurydike. She knows this because we listen. Next: go to Eurydike before the Unbound. Still unknown: seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Collector Ennodius Vanin.
